what: K-WA SUB is a powerful bass synthesizer for the M-VAVE FM-1, featuring 9 synthesis engines with 2 engines playable simultaneously and morphing capabilities. A dedicated sample layer adds attack and texture, while 3 freely assignable MIDI-learnable LFOs, quantized live effects and extensive sound design tools unlock endless possibilities for modern bass creation, from deep subs and reese basses to neuro, wobble and experimental sounds.
